name: Undisclosed recipient
summary: A recipient of personal data is missing from the party's own privacy statement.

mechanism.what: Measurement shows data going to a party that the published privacy statement does not mention, or the statement asserts something the traffic contradicts, such as that no personal data is processed or that all recipients are inside the EEA.
mechanism.why_it_matters: The statement is the one place a person can check what happens to their data. If it is wrong, informed consent is impossible by construction, and every other control rests on nothing.
common_causes: statement not updated when the measurement setup changed
tags added by a team that does not maintain the statement
mechanism.not_this: This is not about whether the processing was lawful. It is about the gap between the measurement and the party's own account of it.

detection.indicator: Set difference: recipients observed in the capture minus recipients named in the privacy statement of the same date is non-empty. Both sources belong to the party; the researcher only does the arithmetic.
capture_requirements: use the statement as it stood on the measurement date, from an archive
search the whole statement and any cookie overview, not just the recipients list

falsifiers.condition: The recipient is named elsewhere in the statement or in a linked cookie overview.
The recipient falls within a category of recipients that the statement does name, and the category is specific enough to identify the kind of party.
falsifiers.note: The provision allows categories. 'Analytics providers' covers an analytics provider; 'our partners' covers nothing. Quote the category verbatim in the finding and let the reader judge it.

falsifiers.condition: The statement was updated outside the measured window.

methods.expect: no dedicated reproduction exists yet; follow the general method and the indicator above

rebuttals.objection: The statement is generic on purpose.
rebuttals.answer: Article 13 requires the recipients or categories of recipients. A statement that omits a category entirely is not generic but incomplete.

seen_in_the_wild.note: Observed in practice by the authors but not yet backed by a published reference. Set to false until a citation exists: a claim without a source is exactly what this catalogue holds others to.

does_not_establish: harm; the catalogue standardises a finding so it can be referred to, it does not weigh it
severity; there is no score here, by design. Weighing belongs to whoever applies the entry to a concrete case
unlawfulness; that is for a supervisory authority or a court
intent; a fault is usually a build decision, not a plan
absence: not finding it in one capture is not evidence that it is not there
summary_nl: Een ontvanger van persoonsgegevens ontbreekt in de eigen privacyverklaring van de partij.

in_practice.dpia: Compare the measured recipients against the recipients named in the published privacy statement of the same date.
in_practice.procurement: Every party receiving personal data is named in the published statement, verified against a capture on delivery.
in_practice.complaint: A capture of recipients plus the archived statement of that date, and the set difference between them.
in_practice.audit_question: Name every party that receives data, then let me check that against the traffic.
in_practice.audit_question_nl: Noem elke partij die gegevens ontvangt, dan leg ik dat naast het verkeer.
in_practice.complaint_nl: De lijst met gemeten ontvangers naast de privacyverklaring zoals die op de meetdatum luidde, en het verschil tussen beide. Beide bronnen zijn van de partij zelf.
in_practice.objection_nl: De verklaring is bewust algemeen gehouden.
in_practice.answer_nl: De wet vraagt de ontvangers of categorieen ervan. Een categorie die ontbreekt is niet algemeen maar onvolledig.
